{{Quote|Is it not beneath you to dismember this unfortunate Trandoshan?|Garsa Fwip, to Black Krrsantan|<ref name="Storm" />}}
A [[Trandoshan]] '''gambler''' was [[gambling]] with some other Trandoshans at the [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|Sanctuary]] [[cantina]] in [[9 ABY]] when they were attacked by the [[Wookiee]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Krrsantan]]. He tried to defend himself by breaking a [[glass]] on the Wookiee's back, but Krrsantan immobilized him right after. Despite the cantina owner [[Garsa Fwip]]'s advice to stop torturing the Trandoshan, Black Krrsantan ripped off his left [[Limb|arm]] and left him on the floor.

==Biography==
{{Quote|So, what say you release this customer and let these fine folks get back to their fun and in return, I will wipe your debt off the books?|Garsa Fwip tries to bargain with Black Krrsantan for the Trandoshan's safety|<ref name="Storm" />}}
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{BoBFDate|4|the [[Trandoshan]]'s appearance}}</ref> a [[Trandoshan]] [[gambler]] played at a [[gambling]] table in the [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|Sanctuary]], a [[cantina]] in the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. The gambler had a streak of winning hands, celebrating with<ref name="Storm" /> his<ref name="Storm AD" /> three comrades. Unbeknownst to them, the [[Wookiee]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Krrsantan]] was staring them down from his booth. Becoming aggravated as he [[Alcohol|drank]] more, the Wookiee made his way to the Trandoshans' gambling table and grabbed the gambler, throwing him across the room. While the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] proceeded to throw the other Trandoshans around, the gambler crawled to his feet and threw a [[glass]] at the back of Krrsantan's head.<ref name="Storm" />

[[File:Santy-gives-a-hug.png|thumb|left|300px|Black Krrsantan attacked the gambler, only for Garsa Fwip to attempt to talk the Wookiee out of dismembering the Trandoshan]]
Krrsantan turned to the Trandoshan gambler, who looked back in fear. The Wookiee then lifted the gambler up to dismember him when [[Garsa Fwip]], the Sanctuary's owner, intervened, attempting to convince the bounty hunter to let the Trandoshan. The helpless gambler squirmed wide-[[eye]]d in the Wookiee's hands<ref name="Storm" /> and whimpered in agreement.<ref name="Junior Novel">[[The Book of Boba Fett Junior Novel|''The Book of Boba Fett'' Junior Novel]]</ref> Fwip offered to wipe Krrsantan's debt if he freed the gambler, but Krrsantan instead chose to rip off the Trandoshan's left [[Limb|arm]], dropping his victim to the floor. The other patrons looked and cried out in horror, and Krrsantan left the cantina.<ref name="Storm" />

==Personality and traits==
The Trandoshan had [[Color|green]] skin and yellow eyes. When Black Krrsantan attacked him and the other Trandoshans, he tried to fight back but soon found himself staring at the Wookiee in fear when he realized he was outmatched.<ref name="Storm" />

==Equipment==
The Trandoshan wore light blue-and-gray [[clothing]] with dark blue trousers, brown-and-black [[boot]]s, and a blue [[belt]] that bore a black pouch on the front of his waist.<ref name="Storm" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trandoshan gambler appeared in "[[Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm]]," the fourth episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'',<ref name="Storm" /> which was released on [[January 19]], [[2022]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}}</ref>
